subject: [hw] T01 -> V14: T16 LSRS/ASRS register form with shift amount 0 returns 0 (should be unchanged)
body:
The differential harness found a real T16 bug: `lsrs r0, r1` and `asrs r0, r1` with r1 == 0 produce 0, but the ARM ARM says a register-specified shift of 0 leaves the value unchanged. `lsls r0, r1` is correct. Repro (asmrun, current core):

  .syntax unified
  .thumb
  .text
  movs r0,#0x5a
  movs r1,#0
  lsrs r0,r1        @ encoding 0x40c8; expected r0=0x5a, got 0x00000000
  udf #254

Same for `asrs r0,r1` (encoding 0x4110? whichever clang emits); `lsls` leaves 0x5a. Amounts 1, 8, 31, 32 behave as expected in my spot checks. Effect on the corpus: k_crc32 thumb-O0 seed 0 matches (all byte-shifts by 0 expected 0 anyway), seeds 1+ differ because the first byte of the CRC input is built with LSRS by 0. Expected seed 1 c08a3379, got 6513d71d. No other T16 mismatch found so far; k14_alu/k14_mem/k14_branch pass at arm-O2 where they do not hit missing classes. I copied k_v14_t16.c to tests/emu/kernels/k08_v14_t16.c (as posted).
